nas.deployment_identity: The existing root must contain a .multica-root-id file whose text matches root_id. The application does not create the root or this identity marker.
nas.deployment_access: The backend service account needs access to the network mount and the existing meeting directory. The marker does not grant filesystem permissions. Only macOS and Linux export servers are supported. Keep allow_local=false for NAS; do not bypass the network mount check to address an unavailable share.

nas.identity_recovery: Ask the deployment administrator to verify the original root, identity marker and directory location. Moved or replaced directories are not accepted as the original destination.
nas.mount_recovery: Ask the deployment administrator to restore the original network mount on the export server before retrying. Opening it on your computer does not restore the server’s mount.

input_materials.manifest_changed: The current list has changed. Your selection is retained; review it before saving.

input_materials.manifest_run_notice: These are the authorized inputs for this run. This does not mean the agent has read all of them.
input_materials.manifest_run_ready: Required inputs were prepared before execution
input_materials.manifest_runtime_upgrade: This runtime needs an update to receive fixed inputs
input_materials.header_changed: This material record has changed. Your selected file is retained; review the current record before adding a version.
input_materials.verification_failed: The check could not be started. Retry the check for this version.
input_materials.provide_matching_copy: Upload a copy with matching content
input_materials.registered_permission_changed: The material was registered. You currently do not have permission to view it or continue.
input_materials.recovery_file_optional: Choose a file here to provide a copy yourself. Retrying the original source does not require an upload.
input_materials.new_version_relationship_hint: A new version does not replace the version selected by existing meeting references or issue input lists. Link or select the new version explicitly when it is ready.
input_materials.view_does_not_replace: Viewing another version does not change existing meeting references or issue input lists.
input_materials.reference_added: This version is linked. Previous references are retained.
input_materials.reference_keeps_previous: This adds the selected fixed version. Previous versions stay linked until you explicitly remove their references in the materials list.
input_materials.remove_reference_hint: Only this reference is removed. The fixed material and references from other meetings or agenda items are retained.
input_materials.link_to_agenda: Link this version to this topic
input_materials.link_to_meeting: Link this version to this meeting
input_materials.reselect_source_hint: Choose the source again for this item. Its existing material record will be retained.
input_materials.manifest_rebase: Keep my selection after reviewing the current list
input_materials.manifest_open_issue: Open issue to edit inputs or start a new run
input_materials.manifest_fixed_run: Viewing another version does not change the inputs pinned to this run. New inputs require a new run from the issue.
input_materials.artifact_reuse_hint: Reuse this exact version as material. Its original review decision is retained.
input_materials.no_attachments: No attachments match this selection. Open the issue to add a file, then refresh.
input_materials.registered_capture_pending: Version registered. Open it to check capture and availability.
input_materials.local_source_not_checked: The original local file has not been checked. This does not affect the status of the saved copy.
input_materials.run_manifest_changed: The saved input manifest changed. Review the current list and confirm a new run again.
input_materials.run_result_unknown: The result of this launch is unconfirmed. Check execution history before authorizing another run; the original run may already exist.
input_materials.run_save_first: Save or finish the pending input edit before starting a new run.
input_materials.run_with_manifest: Start a run with saved inputs
input_materials.run_assign_agent: Assign this issue to an agent before starting a run.
input_materials.run_authorization_effect: This starts a new run with this saved list and may replace a queued run. Existing runs keep their original inputs.
input_materials.run_additional_ack: I checked execution history and authorize an additional run, even if the previous launch succeeded.
input_materials.manifest_other_version: This material already has another version in the selection. Adding this version keeps both; remove the old selection explicitly if it should be replaced.
input_materials.manifest_add_suggested: Add this fixed version to the draft
input_materials.handoff_hint: Choose an existing meeting issue and review its complete input list. The material is handed over only after you save that list.
input_materials.manage_meeting_tasks: Open meeting resources to add or adjust linked issues
input_materials.stop_attempt_hint: Stop the current transfer while keeping the registered material and version. You can inspect it and decide how to resume.
input_materials.manifest_history_notice: This is a saved historical list. Viewing or repairing a material does not replace its fixed selections.
input_materials.artifact_manifest_source: Input manifest used for this version (optional)
input_materials.artifact_incomplete_manifest: The input source selection is incomplete. Choose a saved manifest or clear the selection.
input_materials.restore_reference_protected: Active meeting material references protect this board from full restore. Remove the references in meeting resources first; saved materials and input manifests remain separate.
input_materials.restore_reference_targets: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} affected meetings. Remove their references, then check for the next group.
input_materials.artifact_manifest_location_missing: This version records an input manifest, but its source issue cannot currently be located. Refresh this version to check again.
input_materials.metadata_changed: This record changed. Review its current details before continuing with your edits.
input_materials.archive_hint: Archived material is hidden from the default library. Existing references and fixed versions are retained.
input_materials.unarchive_hint: Return this material to the default library.
input_materials.active_material: Material is in the active library
input_materials.end_registration_hint: The registered material stays in the library. No fixed version or meeting reference has been created. The reason is saved on this device only.
input_materials.local_records_hint: These records describe registrations ended on this device. They are not a shared audit trail.
input_materials.remove_local_record_hint: This removes only this device’s record. The registered material remains in the library.
input_materials.registration_read_unavailable: The registered material is currently unreadable. Its original link is retained.
input_materials.related_tasks_hint: To hand fixed material to a task, open its details and choose “Hand to a linked issue”. Save the task’s input list to use it for new runs.
